details: Characteristic-zero instance of the Yang effective-range bound.
proof: After deleting coordinates constant on the class, every relevant Yang-complex section lies in the boundary of the cross-polytope on $\mathrm E(\mathcal H)$ coordinates. Its homology has dimension at most $\mathrm E(\mathcal H)-1$ over $\mathbb Q$, giving $\mathrm Y_0(\mathcal H)\leq\mathrm E(\mathcal H)$.
name: Effective Range / Characteristic-zero Yang Dimension
witness_verification: For the family #classes/singletons_plus_empty_set with n>=4, the established endpoint values or bounds, in parameter order, are $n$ and $1$. The first parameter divided by one plus the second tends to infinity as n tends to infinity, ruling out every reverse affine-linear bound. See the database-owned value proofs for these two endpoints.
